svg.title: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step three metal lines, each a thick silver film between two thin purple ones, lie buried in a flat pale oxide. After it a violet resist covers the oxide except for two narrow windows, one over the middle line and one over the right-hand line.

svg.text: Before: the cap oxide over metal 1 (step 117)
Resist is coated, exposed through the via reticle
and developed, opening the via windows.
After: resist with two via windows
The lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
